query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
billing_type as "Billing type",
to_char(((booking_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Booking start date and time",
to_char(((booking_end_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Booking end date and time",
case
when extract(day from age(booking_end_datetime, booking_start_datetime)) >= 1
then extract(day from age(booking_end_datetime, booking_start_datetime)) || ' nights'
when extract(hour from age(booking_end_datetime, booking_start_datetime)) >= 1
then extract(hour from age(booking_end_datetime, booking_start_datetime)) || ' hours'
else extract(minute from age(booking_end_datetime, booking_start_datetime)) || ' minutes'
end as "Booking duration",
location_group as "Area",
location as "Location",
clinician as "Clinician",
booking_type as "Booking type",
booking_status as "Booking status"
from "reporting"."ds__location_bookings"
where ((booking_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and
((booking_end_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:locationGroupId is null then true
else location_group_id = 
:locationGroupId
end
and
case
when 
:bookingStatus is null then true
else booking_status = 
:bookingStatus
end
and
case
when 
:clinicianId is null then true
else clinician_id = 
:clinicianId
end
and
case
when 
:bookingTypeId is null then true
else booking_type_id = 
:bookingTypeId
end
order by booking_start_datetime
name: Location bookings line list
notes: This report generates a list of all location bookings for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order by date and time of booking
